acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides whether to recode the three SNAPSHOT_MOVED input-mismatch producers and whether to split transient LIMIT_EXCEEDED, and the decision is recorded in the CAL spec and a build-log entry.
TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md tells clients which of their extra retried codes are not Tasks codes.
Any recode keeps TestCALV0078_ClassificationCoversEveryCode passing and fencing codes not retryable.
body: docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0780-retryable-codes.md (at 618680492cf8, #574) leaves these untracked: (1) three SNAPSHOT_MOVED producers (release candidate head, attestation candidate, criterion capture wrapping a refused read) are input mismatches that repeat until the caller input changes but are classified retryable; recoding them is an owner decision. (2) Transient LIMIT_EXCEEDED cases (64 live preparation slots, active-attempt cap) stay not retryable until split into their own code. (3) The #494 reporter client also retries STALE, HEAD_MOVED and STORAGE_FAILED, which are not section 11 codes, and JOURNAL_SATURATED, which is deliberately not retryable. (4) A claim that ran pool health probes before a later refusal may probe again on retry.
title: corvint-tasks: owner questions left open by V1-0780 retryability (SNAPSHOT_MOVED input mismatches, transient LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
